text: Nuln Ironsides are selected from the guards and apprentices of the famous Imperial Gunnery School, and are among the most respected and best-equipped regiments of handgunners in the Empire.
The handgunners who patrol the crater walls are called Bronzeballs, named after the metal used to forge their shot—though they don't typically do so themselves.

The Sterntower Marksmen are a newly formed regiment of Stirgart. In the shadow of the mighty Black Mountains, they form part of the watchposts and signal towers guarding the low hills of eastern Wissenland.

The Seahawks are one of Nordland's most renowned regiments, made up of more than 20 companies. The Seahawks are usually the first regiment dispatched to support other provinces, so they receive better arms and equipment, as well as higher pay, than most other units.
The Altdorf Honour Company, also known as the Sons of the Reik, is a Reikland regiment renowned for its discipline and fine equipment, dedicated to serving the Emperor and Altdorf.

Once known as the Blades of the Sun, these swordsmen are refugees from the fall of Talabheim. Like other companies formed from survivors, they are devoted to exacting vengeance on the enemies who took their homes, families, and hope.
The halberdiers known as the Death's Heads were founded during the Vampire Wars. They began in the Ostermark town of Essen, during the reign of Vlad von Carstein.
The Empire's true Gryph Knights, not chickens!!!!
Priests who guard the Cathedral of Sigmar, defending it with the power of thunder.
Priests who guard the Cathedral of Sigmar, enchanting their spears with thunder to pierce through their foes.
Elite guardians of the innermost sanctum of the Cathedral of Sigmar, who wield thunderous hammers to annihilate all evil.
They fire thunderous bolts from specialized heavy crossbows, and when necessary, summon natural falcons to aid their marksmanship.
Followers of Taal summon magical war eagles to aid them in battle.
Demigryph Knights who patrol with dual pistols, striking enemies from a distance.
Wielding massive greatswords, cutting down every enemy in their path.
Warriors of Nordland, whose abilities surpass those of most common men.
The Dark Judgement holds no secrets—they appear only on battlefields where Chaos and heresy clash.
Clad in heavy armor, the Reiksguard charge headlong into battle, fighting fiercely amidst the chaos of war.
Part of the Knights Order of the White Wolf, devout followers of Ulric, wielding twin hammers.
A splinter faction of the Knights of Morr, separated due to ideological conflict with the Order of Morr.
A regiment formed by witch hunters within the Empire, specializing in hunting down heretics. They are normally scattered throughout the Empire, gathering together only when needed.
Among the stubborn folk of Ostland, these warriors follow the one called Volkmar, mercilessly destroying approaching enemies with weapons of fire.
